issues.detail: The Hebrew 'וַיַּעֲבֵר יִשַׁי שַׁמָּה' means 'And Jesse made [him] pass by' (i.e., Jesse presented another son to Samuel), not 'Jesse passed through a desolate place.' The word 'שַׁמָּה' is 'there' (adverb of place), not '荒涼之處' (desolate place). The Chinese adds a location concept not in the Hebrew and changes the action from presenting a son to passing through a place.
